title: Polarization-Induced Beam Bending: Mathematical Model, Discretization, and Algorithm
summary: We study a reduced hydrodynamic formulation of paraxial vector beam propagation in which the beam intensity, optical phase, and spatially-dependent polarization are coupled through a nonlinear dispersive system. While prior analytical work derived a solution for the beam path valid for short propagation distances, a fully resolved numerical treatment of the model over long ranges has not previously been available. Here we present a conservative numerical scheme for the coupled system, combining a finite-volume discretization of the intensity equation with monotone Hamilton--Jacobi (H-J)…
